messages:
Noah L: hi folks, I'm Noah, first day on infra. following the obs onboarding but hit a weird combo: Grafana panels embedded in the docs are blank (just a grey box) and Datadog Log Explorer gives 403. Sentry link for inference-runtime returns \"no access\". my okta is noah.l@redwood.ai. any clues?

devex-bot: welcome @Noah L! please paste your email and which dashboards/projects you need. onboarding: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. if it's urgent tag @Infra Ops. :wave:

Noah L: email above. need read to Grafana folder "inference/overview", datadog logs for inference-prod, and Sentry project-view for inference-runtime-prod.

Renee K: congrats on joining! short checklist: 1) try incognito to rule out cookie loops, 2) confirm Okta groups include redwood-observability, 3) are you on VPN or office network? sometimes the office proxy rewrites headers and breaks embeds.

Noah L: incognito same blank embed. Okta shows me in redwood-observability. i'm on the home VPN (company VPN).

Renee K: VPN is interesting  our embed proxy expects X-Forwarded-For and some header passthrough that certain VPNs strip. that causes Grafana embed proxy to set X-Frame-Options or be blocked. also Datadog 403 often means SCIM role didn't apply to your API token mapping. i'm going to trigger a SCIM sync and refresh Grafana ACLs for you.

Renee K: kicking sync now and bumping grafana ACL cache for noah.l@redwood.ai.

Grafana Bot: Provisioning update: folder membership (inference/overview) applied for noah.l@redwood.ai, ACL cache refreshed.

Noah L: grafana panels still blank after refresh. browser console shows: "Refused to display 'https://grafana.redwood.internal' in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'sameorigin'" and a few mixed-content warnings.

Renee K: that confirms the embed proxy headers are being stripped by the VPN/proxy. can you temporarily disconnect VPN and try again? if that fixes it we'll escalate to Network to adjust header passthrough for the VPN.

Noah L: disconnected from VPN and embeds render correctly now  panels visible.

Renee K: great. for Datadog 403, can you run this quick check (use the workspace token from the vault):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" \
  -H "DD-API-KEY: <workspace-token>" \
  "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list"
```

Noah L: ran it, returns 403.

Renee K: i see the SCIM sync completed but the datadog role assignment failed to apply for a handful of users due to a race. i'll manually add datadog-log-read to your identity record and resend the Sentry invite. give me ~2m.

Infra Ops: manually granted datadog-log-read and grafana-viewer for noah.l@redwood.ai. Sentry project invite for inference-runtime-prod sent.

Noah L: reran curl  now returns 200. Sentry invite accepted and i can view errors. thanks!

SRE Oncall: quick note  the VPN header passthrough change is a known gap; we'll add a short section to the onboarding doc explaining the VPN disconnect workaround and network will patch the VPN to preserve embedded headers by next week.

Noah L: awesome. follow-up Q: who should I ping to add p95/p99 lines to latency charts and tweak an alert threshold? i don't want to change alerts without review.

Renee K: dashboards are owned by infra-observability. small visual tweaks (p95/p99, tooltip text) are fine via a PR to repos/infrastructure/grafana-dashboards (export the JSON and include a short description). alert threshold changes need approval from infra-observability and SRE Oncall to avoid noise. post a short note in #observability-dashboards tagging them. if you want temp grafana-editor to prototype, request here.

Noah L: can i get grafana-editor for 12h to prototype? i'll open a PR and tag infra-observability + SRE before merging.

Renee K: granted grafana-editor to noah.l@redwood.ai for 12h. please remember to export dashboards as JSON and follow the repo template.

Noah L: thanks everyone  everything working and i have editor access to prototype. i'll open the PR with p95/p99 and a brief rationale. closing this thread. :heart:
